claim_text: A 31-year-old cyclist was found dead early Sunday 16 August 2026 in a hole that opened up on a washed-out road in Henry County, east of Indianapolis, and the county coroner said the man appears to have gone around a barricade and fallen into the collapsed road.
quote: Among the latest confirmed victims was a 31-year-old cyclist found dead early Sunday in a hole that opened up on a washed-out road in Henry County, east of Indianapolis.
confidence_justification: Death confirmed and attributed to a named county coroner, but the coroner's account of how it happened is stated as an appearance, not a finished determination.
